newsitem.title: UK: Tate slips to 6-month low on downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Tate slips to 6-month low on downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Tate & Lyle slipped to a six-month low on Tuesday following talk that brokerage NatWest downgraded the stock, dealers said.
By 0848 GMT, the shares were trading at 431-1/2p, down 10p from yesterday and down some 53-1/2p, or 11 percent, since January 9.
Dealers said there was talk in the market that the brokerage had cut its earnings estimates by 15 million stg, which may have established a new low among industry estimates.
The shares have been under increasing pressure in recent weeks about concerns that the decline in price of high fructose sweetners will hit Tate's profits.
The company is set to hold its annual meeting on Thursday.
